The first term is $1$ and the common difference is $14$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{+14\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{+14\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{+14\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$1,$ | | $15,$ | | $29,$ | | $43,...$

This is the recursive formula of $1, 15, 29, 43,...$

$\begin{cases}
a(1)=1
\\\\
a(n)=a(n-1)+14
\end{cases}$
